versions.changelog:
Initial release of Video AI Analyzer:

- Supports analysis of videos from platforms like Toutiao, Douyin, Bilibili, Xigua, Xiaohongshu, and Kuaishou.
- Automatically downloads videos, transcribes speech to text, and converts between Simplified and Traditional Chinese.
- Handles Mandarin, Cantonese, other dialects, and foreign languages; extracts audio transcripts, voiceover scripts, and scene descriptions.
- Custom prompts enable generation of summaries, rewrites, golden quote extraction, storyboards, and Chinese-English translation.
- Filters out filler words, verbal slips, and repetitive content for clean, reusable transcripts.
- Requires GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN for use; focused on privacy and enterprise-grade use cases.
